text: API keys are created per agent and scoped to a single Buyer or Seller agent
quote: API keys are created and managed in your Agent Dashboard, and each key is scoped to a single agent (Buyer or Seller).

text: Developers can create identity/payment tokens via a Playground or directly through the API
quote: Create your first token in the Playground (or directly via the API with the pre-filled parameters).

text: Sellers create a new service (name, type, pricing, identity requirements) and submit it for Skyfire's approval
quote: Click Create Service and provide details like: name, type, pricing, identity requirements, etc. Submit for approval.

text: Sellers charge a buyer-issued pay/kya-pay token via API after delivering the service to collect payment
quote: Charge a `pay` or `kya-pay` token as a seller agent or seller service. Use this API after delivering a service, tool, or resource to collect payment from a buyer-issued token.

text: Buyers/sellers can check whether a token is still usable and see its remaining balance
quote: Check whether a token is currently usable and get the remaining balance as a buyer or seller agent.

text: An official MCP server lets agents discover sellers, generate kya/pay tokens, and run commerce workflows
quote: Add the Skyfire MCP server ... Your agent is now ready to discover sellers, generate `kya` or `pay` tokens, and instantly execute agentic commerce workflows!

text: Docs describe how sellers must expose which token types (kya/pay/kya-pay) are required and how tokens are passed via a header
quote: Create an MCP Server Resource that explains which token types are required (`kya`, `pay`, and/or `kya-pay`), how tokens must be passed (the `kyapay-token` header), and when a payment token is required versus identity only.

text: Know Your Agent (KYA) provides a single identity verification that covers both a user's buyer and seller agents
quote: Skyfire supports identity verification through Know Your Agent (KYA), a single verification that applies to both your buyer and seller agents.

text: kya-pay tokens combine identity and payment authorization, letting sellers offer guest checkout to buyer agents
quote: Sellers can use a `kya-pay` token to enable a guest checkout experience for buyer agents.

text: Sites/bot managers can recognize verified agent identity and let it through instead of blocking it with captchas/403s
quote: The site, or the bot manager in front of it, can then identify the agent/agent platform and allow it through rather than block it.

text: Signing up automatically creates a Buyer Agent with a pre-funded wallet, ready to pay for services immediately
quote: On signup, your Buyer Agent is created automatically, along with a pre-funded wallet so you can start using paid services right away.

text: A Directory lets agents browse and find services they can access programmatically
quote: Browse the **Directory** to find services your agent can access programmatically.

text: A Credits Wallet Embed SDK lets enterprise customers embed wallet-funding flows directly into their own app
quote: Skyfire's Credits Wallet Embed SDK lets Skyfire Enterprise Customers embed wallet funding directly into their own application, through a secure, hosted flow.

text: A Payments React SDK lets developers build agentic card-payment purchase flows
quote: This page explains how agentic purchases with a payment card are built with Skyfire's **Payments React SDK**.

text: An organization can configure itself as a single unified seller its customers' agents transact with
quote: Your organization can act as a unified seller that your own customers' agents transact with.

text: Organization admins can create seller agents on behalf of users in their org
quote: As an Organization Admin, create a seller agent for a user in your organization.

text: Sellers are guaranteed payment for charges within a valid token; they don't bear buyer non-payment risk
quote: Sellers do not carry buyer non-payment risk for charges within a valid token.

text: Reused identity verification lets a user's buyer/seller agents share account creation, auth, and access to services
quote: That verified identity can be reused by the user's agents for account creation, authentication, and access to seller services.

text: The identity token is described as accepted broadly across the commercial internet for access, login, and checkout
quote: An extensible identity token accepted by the majority of the commercial internet, enabling the entire agentic customer journey from access to login to checkout.

text: Skyfire partners with major card networks for tokenized card transactions and collecting user payment mandates
quote: Skyfire partners with all major credit card networks to allow tokenized card transactions and user mandate collection so agents can reliably checkout out at the scale of the internet.

quote: Set Agent's Source IP Addresses

text: Verified buyers unlock a broader set of seller services that require trusted credentials
quote: Verified buyers can use a broader set of seller services, including those that require trusted credentials.
